title: Tanager - SE implementation docket
content:
Context:
Customer: Tanager Inc. (fintech) - on-prem-adjacent VPC deployment behind strict egress. Tight audit/KMS requirements.
Objective: Get Private deployment in their single VPC region with zero-downtime cutover from POC instance; enforce KMS-managed keys and mutual TLS between control-plane and serving nodes.

High-level plan (phases):
1) Preflight (this week) - confirm network, certs, credentials.
   - ask: can they open 443/8443 between control-plane and serving subnets? (Slack + infra)
   - collect: list of CIDR blocks for peering, route tables, NACLs
   - verify: internal DNS patterns (use: tanager.int.company -> map to ENI)
   - KMS: confirm key rotation window and HSM integration (need contact at security)

2) Staging deploy (next week) - dry-run of installation into staging VPC with mirrored constraints.
   - provision: 2-node serving pool (g5x2 equiv) + control plane in private subnet
   - config: pin model to rdl/llama-70b-int8-v2 (customer requires on-prem open model)
   - disable external logs by default, enable audit forwarding to their Splunk collector

3) Cutover & validation (week after) - migrate traffic with canary routing.
   - route policy: 10% canary to new private, 90% to POC for 24h
   - metrics: latency p50/p95, token cost, error rate, KV cache hit rate
   - rollback plan: scalable fallback to hosted endpoint with transient token override (pre-approved)

Action items (me):
- [ ] Get CIDR + example route table from Tanager infra (assigned: Maya to nudge) (due: 2025-11-05)
- [ ] Create staging terraform skeleton for VPC peering + subnet mapping (me) (due: 2025-11-07)
- [ ] Draft KMS integration doc + questions for security (me, attach to Confluence) (due: 2025-11-06)
- [ ] Small script to validate mutual TLS between control-plane and serving (poC) (Jordan to review) (due: 2025-11-08)
- [ ] Verify model quantization/packaging pipeline for customer's model (note: they want int8 but still worry about quality) (me)
- [ ] Add Splunk forwarder config snippet to deployment repo (me)

Quick config notes (copyable):
- kubeconfig context name: tanager-stage
- terraform workspace: tanager-stage
- example security group rules:
  - allow tcp:8443 from 10.10.0.0/16 (control-plane -> serving)
  - allow tcp:443 from 10.20.0.0/16 (backend -> control-plane)

CLI quick checks:
- curl -k https://control-plane.internal:8443/healthz (expect 200)
- openssl s_client -connect serving-node:8443 -servername serving.internal -showcerts

Config snippet for mutual TLS (notes to self):
- Generate CSR on control-plane, sign with customer CA; ensure SANs include internal FQDNs
- Add CA cert bundle to serving trusted store at /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/tanager-ca.pem
- systemd unit restart sequence: control-plane -> wait 45s -> serving agents restart

Risk register (short):
- KMS policy mismatch could block automated key access for runtime (mitigation: manual approve flow + security walkthrough)
- Network ACLs blocking ephemeral ports during autoscale (mitigation: narrow ephemeral port range + test)
- Model quality regression after int8 (mitigation: keep optuna eval set to run nightly; baseline tests before cutover)

Meeting notes (2025-11-04 sync call):
- Tanager infra will provide route tables by EOD Friday.
- They insist on quarterly key rotations; we need to confirm support in agent (security says ok but need runbook).
- Ask: do they want per-tenant audit logs or aggregated? (they prefer per-tenant).

Open questions / blockers:
- Does on-prem HSM require a proxy or can we call their KMS endpoint directly from our control-plane? (TODO: escalate to infra eng)
- If we enable Splunk forwarding from the serving nodes, will they accept the connection or require a forwarder appliance? (confirm)

Notes to self (short):
- Keep doc concise for handoff to Jordan before PTO.
- Record short screencast of staging deploy steps for their SREs.

Short timeline draft (one-liner):
Preflight: 3 days -> Staging deploy: 5 days -> Canary + validation: 3 days -> Production cutover: 1 day (contingency 1 week)

References / links to attach later:
- Confluence: TNGR-setup-guide (placeholder)
- Repo: github.com/redwood/tanager-deploy-config (TODO: branch + PR)
summary: Personal SE scratchpad for Tanager deployment. Contains action items, networking and cert notes, quick CLI checks, risks, and meeting notes. Prioritized checklist for staging and cutover.
